items.headline: California Governor Commutes Sentences of All 548 Death Row Inmates
items.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom announced the commutation of all 548 death sentences in the state to life imprisonment without the possibility of parole. This historic decision represents the largest mass clemency in modern U.S. history, reducing the nation's total death row population by nearly a third.

items.headline: Tech Stocks Plunge as Regulatory Concerns Trigger Major AI Market Sell-Off
items.summary: Technology stocks experienced a massive sell-off on November 5, wiping out over $2 trillion in market value and driving the Nasdaq into correction territory. Investors reacted with alarm to potential regulatory hurdles and tighter oversight for AI data centers following recent U.S. midterm election results.

items.headline: Ferencváros Stuns AC Milan with 2-0 Europa League Victory
items.summary: Hungarian side Ferencváros secured a surprising 2-0 win against AC Milan at San Siro during Thursday's UEFA Europa League match. Forward Lenny Joseph scored twice in the second half, handing the Italian hosts their third defeat in four European games this season.

items.headline: Pixar President Jim Morris Steps Down as Jonathan Garson Is Named Successor
items.summary: Longtime Pixar Animation Studios President Jim Morris announced he is stepping down after 12 years in the top executive role to become president emeritus. Disney veteran Jonathan Garson will officially succeed Morris as the studio's next president on January 4, 2027.
